purpose: Round G: the per-criterion proof level and the pin successors, every test driving bin/rcf.js against a fixture project (e2e): test strength, the Test verdict, Finalise and separation per level (AC-19905-1 to -9, -12), the writer and the enum refusal (AC-19905-10, -11), and the probe shapes at the pin at rcf-schemas 0.11.0 (AC-19905-13 to -15, and the own chain at that pin, AC-19905-16), and the proof downgrade guard: a lightening update refused without a non-empty --reason, the reason recorded in the decisions ledger, creating and tightening direct (AC-19905-17 to -22), and the gate invariant and the blueprint lightening path: rcf build verdict review and light Finalise refuse a criterion lighter at head than at the base without a resolved decision, blueprint version replacement refused without --reason, the reasoned retry idempotent (AC-19905-23 to -30), and the gate failing closed: a passing review verdict refused when the base cannot be resolved, and a resolved decision with an absent, empty or whitespace-only answer counted as undecided at Review and light Finalise (AC-19905-31 to -34), and the gate story discovery from two complete snapshots: a C-quoted, renamed, moved, split or shadowed story, a symlink or gitlink, a duplicated id, an unparseable story or an unreadable blob, a deleted criterion, a lighter successor and a retirement with no successor at Review and light Finalise, and a dirty working tree refusing both (AC-19905-35 to -49)
